findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: The lemonade nozzle, hibiscus refresher nozzle, pineapple refresher nozzle, and horchata nozzle were all observed to have an accumulation of soil residue in them. CORRECTED- These nozzles were cleaned during the inspection and it was discussed with the PIC to frequently clean drink nozzles. Ensure that nozzles are being regularly cleaned to maintain them clean to sight and touch.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Thermometers are provided and accurate.
findings.comment: There are no ambient thermometers observed in the hot holding display cases. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that there are ambient thermometers in all hot and cold holding units.
findings.citation_text: 4-204.112(A) Temperature Measuring Devices. (A) In a mechanically refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, the sensor of a TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure the air temperature or a simulated product temperature in the warmest part of a mechanically refrigerated unit and in the coolest part of a hot FOOD storage unit.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display.
findings.comment: There are cases of water bottles that are being stored outside in front of the facility. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that the cases of water bottles are stored inside of the facility to protect them from contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11 Miscellaneous Sources of Contamination. FOOD shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 - 3-306.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. The bottom of the preparation cooler in the kitchen. 
2. FIRST REPEAT- The kitchen walk-in cooler fan covers. 
3. FIRST REPEAT- Inside of the cabinets under the coffee machines. 
4. The floor under and behind the soda syrups in the back room. 

This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-602.13 Nonfood-Contact Surfaces. NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink in the kitchen and the triple sink are observed to be in need of being re-sealed to the wall. This was discussed with the PIC. Ensure that physical facilities are maintained in good repair.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink in the kitchen had recently been fixed and did not have any paper towels available at it. CORRECTED- PIC placed paper towels at the handwashing sink. Ensure that all handwashing sinks are provided with individual, disposable towels to allow for the use of a barrier for proper handwashing.
findings.citation_text: 6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: The handwashing sink next to the pizza prep cooler in the kitchen was observed to have a trash can in front of it. This sink was previously clogged and had recently been fixed, but was still not in use (there is a second handwashing sink in the kitchen). CORRECTED- The trash can was moved and the sink was stocked to become available for use. Ensure that handwashing sinks are maintained to be accessible at all times for employee use.
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11 Using a Handwashing Sink. (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment: There was a phone observed to be on the table of the prep cooler. CORRECTED- This phone was removed and the PIC was educated on the importance of keeping food contact surfaces clean. Phones hold a significant amount of bacteria and should never be in contact with a food contact surface. This table was sanitized during the inspection.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of cleaning: 

1. Kitchen walk-in cooler fans 
2. REPEAT- Behind the soda machines
3. Cabinet underneath coffee machines
4. REPEAT- Shelves above the dough/pizza prep area. 

Ensure that nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: The mop bucket was observed to still contain used waste water. CORRECTED- The PIC dumped the mop bucket out and was educated on the importance of making sure the waste water is dumped after use. Sewage should always be conveyed to the point of disposal.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.12: (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. 

An employee was observed to wash their hands and then use their bare hands to turn off the faucet. Education was conducted and the employee re-washed their hands to correct. Ensure that staff is properly trained and washes their hands correctly moving forward.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
2-301.14: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of their arms immediately before engaging in FOOD preparation including (A)-(I) any activities that may have contaminated the hands.  

An employee was observed to change gloves without washing hands. Education was conducted and the PIC instructed to ensure hand swashing takes place at all times that it is required.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

The lettuce slicer in the kitchen is observed soiled with dry food debris. The PIC indicated that it was likely from a couple days ago. Cleaning was discussed and the item moved to dish for thorough cleaning. Ensure all food contact items are cleaned after use.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container
findings.comment:
3-302.12: If in working container, FOOD not readily recognized or easily mistakable shall be identified with the common name of the FOOD. 

A container of sauce in the pizza prep cooler is without a label. The sauce was identified as garlic sauce and a label added to the container to correct. Ensure that labels are included on all containers with food.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. 

Multiple locations throughout the facility are in need of detail cleaning. These locations are predominantly behind/ under shelving and equipment next to the wall/ floor junctions. Other areas include ice in the walk in freezer, shelves above the dough/pizza prep and the corner of the lid of the pizza prep cooler. Cleaning is also needed under the milk storage in the display cooler and under/behind the drink stations. Clean all of the facility and ensure that it is maintained clean moving forward.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies. 

A mop is observed stored with the head pooled up in the mop sink. The PIC was consulted and instructed to store the mops so that they hang/dry. The mop was moved to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
The hand sink next to the pizza prep cooler was observed without paper towels. Each hand sink must be supplied with paper towels. Paper towels were stocked at the hand sink during the inspection to correct the violation. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
The area behind the soda nozzles on the soda machine was observed soiled. These non-food contact surfaces must be cleaned frequently to preclude the accumulation of soil residues. 

4-602.13: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The floor-wall junctures near the mop sink were not sealed or covered. Ensure coving/baseboards or caulking is placed over the floor-wall junctures so they are properly sealed. 

6-201.13: (A) floor and wall junctures shall be coved and closed to no larger than 1mm (one thirty-second inch). (B) Floors in which water flush cleaning methods are used shall be provided with drains and be graded to drain. Floor and wall junctures shall be coved and SEALED.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: 2-301.12: (A) Observed food employee put on a new pair of gloves without first washing hands.  Employees must wash hand before putting on a new pair of gloves. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment: 5-205.11: (A) Observed spoon with food debris in the basin of the hand sink next to pizza prep cooler. A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment: 2-301.12: (A) Observed food employee put on a new pair of gloves without first washing hands.  Employees must wash hand before putting on a new pair of gloves. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands and exposed portions of arms for at least 20 seconds. (B) FOOD EMPLOYEES shall use proper procedure (C) To prevent recontamination, FOOD EMPLOYEES may use barrier to operate faucet handles. (D) Automatic handwashing facility may be used if APPROVED.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.12: (A) Observed shelving located above pizza prep cooler to be soiled with food debris.  PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment: 6-501.12: (A) Observed floor on sides and behind pizza oven to soiled with food debris.  PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.citation_text: 3-307.11  (C) Observed cup used for scoop in container of nacho tortillas chips used for pizzas.  Use a scoop with a handle that does not come into contact with food to avoid contamination.  Food shall be protected from contamination. Reference 3-307.11.

findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.citation_text: 4-903.11(A) and (C)  (C) (1) Observed single use cups and paper towels stored directly on the floor next to automatic teller machine.  (2) Observed a box of pizza dough stored directly on the floor in the walk in cooler. Single-Use Articles shall be stored: 1) in a clean and dry location; 2) away or protected from contamination; 3) at least six inches above the floor; 4) covered or inverted. Reference 4-903.11(A) and (C).

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: 750-1300 Bottle of sanitizer is observed without a label on the bottle. Labeled during the inspection. Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.citation_text: 750.140(a) See notes in General Commentws. The open air display sandwich cooler is observed holding temperatures at rising degrees with descending storage. It is recommended that a thermometer be placed front and center on the lowest shelf in order to monitor what is possibly the warmest part of this cooler. Foods should be held at 41F or below. There is currently no thermometer observed within the cooler. All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a  conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.

findings.title: Hands washed, good hygienic practices (observed).
findings.comment: 750-510d Observed employees washing their hands and turning off the faucet before reaching for a paper towel to dry hands. Clean hands touching a soiled faucet handle will again soil the hands. See that hands are washed, dried, and then the paper towel is used to turn off the faucet. To avoid re-contaminating their hands, food employees shall use disposable paper towels or similar clean barriers when touching surfaces such as manually operated faucet handles on a hand-washing sink or the handle of a restroom door.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-690 The Iced Coffee To Go cold holding unit is observed with a significant block of ice on the interior, lower left of the unit. The product is still being held at around 41F. See that the unit is defrosted and serviced if necessary. Ice accumulation may sometime mean that air is not moving properly through the unit. Non-food contact surfaces shall be designed and fabricated to be smooth, washable, free from unnecessary ledges, projections, or crevices and readily accessible for cleaning, and shall be of such material and in such repair as to be easily maintained in a clean and sanitary condition.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: 750-1300 The bleach spray being used for food contact surface sanitizing in the sandwich shop is observed at well over 200ppm Cl. Purpose of spray bottle cleaning/sanitizing/disinfecting was discussed. The spray bottle does appear to be used for food contact surfaces and so should have a lower concentration. Bottles of bleach used to deter mold growth in bathrooms and around sinks should be properly labeled for such purposes.  Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed a container of American cheese to be stored on the counter top and to have an internal temperature of 59F. Temperature was taken with a recently calibrated, metal stem thermometer. Cheese was discarded to correct the violation. Ensure all potentially hazardous foods are maintained at 41F or below or 135F or above.
750-120(a) Potentially hazardous foods, shall be maintained at a proper product temperature at all times during storage (41°F or below, or 135°F or above)

findings.title: Potentially hazardous foods properly thawed
findings.comment: Observed a package of pepperoni to be improperly thawing on the counter top. Internal temperatures indicated a range of 28-39F. Pepperoni was placed into refrigeration to correct the violation. Proper thawing methods was discussed with kitchen management. 750-240 Potentially hazardous foods shall be properly thawed by one of the  following method. 1. Under refrigeration 41°F or below, 2. Under  potable running water 70°F or below or below with sufficient water velocity to agitate and float off loose food particles into the over-flow, 3. In microwave as part of the cooking process, 4. As part of the cooking process.

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
REPEAT 1X> Observed multiple dispensing utensils in the pizza prep cooler to not have handles. Provide dispensing utensils with handles to minimize possible hand contact with food.
750-280 To avoid unnecessary manual contact with food, suitable dispensing utensils shall be used by employees or provided to consumers who serve themselves..
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: 1) Observed a soiled pizza cutter and knife in the kitchen counter top. Providing a wash, rinse, and sanitize schedule for in-use food contact surfaces such as utensils and cutting boards was discussed with management. 2) Observed the ice shoots of the soda fountain to have a slight accumulation of possible pink slime mold. Wash, rinse, and sanitize this food contact surface. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use. 750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment:
Observed a spray bottle of glass cleaner, a spray bottle of sanitizer, and a spray bottle with an unidentifiable contents to not be properly labeled. Items were labeled to correct the violation.
750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Observed two containers of ready-to-eat, potentially hazardous foods (pre-cooked sausage & Canadian bacon) to be past their 7 day maximum holding times. Items were dated 10/20 and 10/21. Foods were voluntarily discarded to correct the violation.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the ate or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: No thermometer available in hot holding (non-pizza) cabinet. Provide a thermometer to ensure foods are maintained at 135F or above.
findings.citation_text: 750.150(a) All hot units that contain potentially hazardous foods shall contain  a conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F

findings.title: In-use food dispensing utensils properly stored.
findings.comment:
Observed multiple cups used for dispensing and measuring stored in containers holding food. Dispensing utensils stored in the food shall have handles provided. Provide scoops with handles for dispensing utensils.
750-280 To avoid unnecessary manual contact with food, suitable dispensing utensils shall be used by employees or provided to consumers who serve themselves..
750-280 Food dispensing utensils shall be stored in the food with the handle extending out of the food; or stored clean and dry; or stored in running potable water dipper wells.

findings.title: Wiping cloths clean, used properly, stored
findings.comment:
Observed multiple soiled wiping cloths stored on table/counter tops throughout the kitchen. Instructed staff that wiping cloths shall be stored in sanitizer solution buckets between uses.
750-810b Moist cloths used for wiping food spills on kitchenware and food-contact surfaces shall be clean and rinsed frequently in one of the permitted sanitizing solutions. See Section 750.820e.   These cloths shall be stored in a proper sanitizing solution between uses.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment:
1) Observed the floor and drain grate below the soda syrup boxes to be soiled with an accumulation of debris and possible slime molds. Clean and maintain this floor.
750-1220 Floors shall be kept clean. Clean the floors.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
1) Observed the joint between the wall and top ledge the mop sink to have a gap. Caulk this joint to eliminate the gap to allow for a smooth and cleanable surface.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.
